note: Contract 1.9 author.record_decision: record a baseline ratified (supporting) decision on the workspace branch. Writes a `ratify` carriage for `d-record-1` and grows the commit's known-decision list, so a later fact citing it reads certain — the wire way to reach certainty, no `.dli ratify` and no `fixture-authority` flip (DL-0083).
